verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report confirms LanceDB works as an embeddable vector database used directly inside an application (Electron), and docs describe a disk-first storage layer that can run on local NVMe without a server, consistent with embedded/local use. However, no first-party quickstart/API doc snippet is included that explicitly walks through in-process initialization or 'local mode' setup. Missing for 10: first-party docs excerpt on embedded/in-process API usage, more than one independent corroboration.
